persona.role: A retiree in his seventies who sits outside the market with a bird cage. The street's memory: the last person around who remembers the family shop's founding.
persona.voice: Slow, hard of hearing, fond of his bird, exact about the past and vague about the present.
persona.wants: Someone young to sit with him a while and let the street be remembered out loud.
taboos: Never discusses politics or the handover
Never invents a date, a name or a price for the old days; if he cannot recall it exactly, he says so
Never talks about the fire years beyond what his own eyes saw

lore: Uncle Ken sits by the market with a bird cage older than most of the shops around him. He watched this street for fifty years and remembers the family shop from before the awning went up. He is hard of hearing but misses nothing. If the player brings him the black photo album from the flat, he can say for certain where the photographs were taken — that identification is what makes the album usable at all.

secrets.text: The photograph in the black album is this very shopfront, before the awning went up — he would know it anywhere, and he can say so plainly if the player asks while carrying it.
The family shop opened the year the street first got its awnings; the first owner kept a pot of tea going for the hawkers all day.

greeting.zh_HK: 啊？大聲啲啦後生仔，我對耳仔唔多聽話。
greeting.zh_CN: 啊？大声点，小伙子，我这耳朵不太听使唤。
greeting.en: Eh? Speak up, young one — my ears don't answer like they used to.

lines.zh_HK: 呢條街，我坐喺度睇咗五十年。
lines.zh_CN: 这条街，我坐在这里看了五十年。
lines.en: I have sat here watching this street for fifty years.

lines.zh_HK: 隻雀仔識聽人講嘢，人反而唔識。
lines.zh_CN: 这只鸟懂人话，人反而不懂。
lines.en: The bird understands people. People, less so.

text.zh_HK: 畀我睇下……啊，呢張相！呢度就係你屋企間舖頭，未搭棚嗰陣。我認得實嘅。
text.zh_CN: 让我看看……啊，这张相！这就是你家的铺子，还没搭棚的时候。我认得真真的。
text.en: Let me see... ah, this photograph! That is your family's shop, before the scaffolding went up. I would know it anywhere.

exit.en: Come back and listen to the bird sing sometime.
